initial_training.expanded_protocol: 16 predetermined/widely distributed native 4x32 regions per training survey; 15000 deterministic feature examples per region

causal_target_information.prefix_relationship: both Waka prefix tiles occur earlier in trace order than the hard target tile
causal_target_information.prefix_adaptation: decoder-reproducible AdamW passes over already decoded prefix
causal_target_information.within_target_adaptation: score each completed trace before decoder-reproducible SGD update from that trace

expanded_universal_larger_prefix8_plus_o.interpretation: Increasing model size gives only marginal gain; capacity is not the dominant remaining bottleneck.

two_model_probability_ensemble.mixture: fixed 50/50 probability average; both models causally adapted

causal_boundary_replacement.method: three topology-specific residual probability tables learned only from earlier decoded Waka prefix tiles: origin, first-column, temporal-edge

negative_followups.larger_model: only marginally better than smaller universal model after adaptation
negative_followups.survey_regime_experts: prefix identifies Kahu as closest expert, but select-then-adapt is worse than pooled multi-survey model
negative_followups.tiny_logit_calibration: cheap correction layer does not match full causal model adaptation

interpretation: Broad independent-survey diversity plus decoder-reproducible learning from the beginning of the target file nearly eliminates the previous same-survey training advantage on hard Waka. The strongest current causal ideal-rate estimate is about 1.727x versus matched SZ3, but it is not a 2x result and not a production codec. The remaining gap is about 0.128 bps, indicating that further progress must primarily reduce interior waveform probability cost rather than startup/boundary overhead or simply increase neural model size.
limitations: Probability rates are ideal code-length diagnostics; an arithmetic/range stream has not been materialized for these learned probabilities.
Distributed/pretrained model bytes are not charged in these diagnostic rates.
Some adaptation hyperparameters were screened on the hard Waka diagnostic and therefore must be frozen and revalidated on fresh held-out positions before any headline claim.
Production speed and memory require a separate optimized implementation benchmark.
